title: Accessibility Report
noData: Pick a WCAG level, then run the scan.

errors.noProject: Select a project before running a scan.

description: Checks WCAG 2.2 in every markup the project ships (HTML, JSX/TSX, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Angular, Razor/Blazor, PHP/Blade, Twig, ERB, Handlebars) and its stylesheets: text alternatives, labels, names, headings, keyboard, ARIA, captions, focus, contrast and target size. Scores the project, scans the running app, and makes simple fixes on a review branch.

score.title: Accessibility score
score.explain: 0 to 100: every violation weighs by its severity, against the number of files scanned. The same code always scores the same, so scans compare over time.
score.noLang_one: {{count}} page does not declare its language: {{files}}
score.noLang_other: {{count}} pages do not declare their language: {{files}}
score.pages: Pages and components that cost the most
score.firstScan: First scan: the next ones will show the trend.
score.trendSame_one: Same score as the previous scan ({{count}} scan)
score.trendSame_other: Same score as the previous scan ({{count}} scans)
score.trendUp_one: Up {{delta}} since the previous scan ({{count}} scan)
score.trendUp_other: Up {{delta}} since the previous scan ({{count}} scans)
score.trendDown_one: Down {{delta}} since the previous scan ({{count}} scan)
score.trendDown_other: Down {{delta}} since the previous scan ({{count}} scans)

notes.conditionalHint: Inside markup that may not render: check it in the state where it shows.
notes.externalHint: A component from a package: pass the missing prop where you use it, or report it to its maintainer.

fix.available_one: {{count}} violation can be fixed in one click
fix.available_other: {{count}} violations can be fixed in one click
fix.aiAlt: Write alt texts with the AI model
fix.serverOnly: Fixes are made on a review branch of a project of this computer.
fix.done_one: {{count}} fix committed on {{branch}}: review the diff on its Kanban card, then open the pull request.
fix.done_other: {{count}} fixes committed on {{branch}}: review the diff on its Kanban card, then open the pull request.
fix.nothing: Nothing to fix on the review branch: the code there has changed since the scan.
fix.missing_one: {{count}} fix was not found on the branch.
fix.missing_other: {{count}} fixes were not found on the branch.

dynamic.title: Scan the running app
dynamic.explain: Opens the app (App Emulator or a localhost URL) in a hidden window, presses Tab through it, reads what a screen reader gets, and measures the rendered contrast.

img-alt.suggestion: Add alt="what the image shows", or alt="" when it is decorative

img-alt-meaningful.description: Image alternative is a file name or a placeholder
img-alt-meaningful.suggestion: Describe what the image shows, not its file

svg-img-name.description: SVG with role="img" has no name
svg-img-name.suggestion: Add a <title> as first child, or aria-label

control-label.suggestion: Link a <label for="id">, wrap it in <label>, or add aria-label; a placeholder is not a label

button-name.suggestion: Give it text, or aria-label for an icon-only button

link-name.suggestion: Give it text that says where it goes, or aria-label

heading-order.suggestion: Go down one level at a time (h2 after h1, h3 after h2)

page-lang.suggestion: Add lang to <html>, for example <html lang="en">

page-title.suggestion: Add a <title> that says what the page is

tabindex-positive.suggestion: Use tabindex="0" (or -1) and order the markup instead

click-without-keyboard.description: Clickable element the keyboard cannot reach or use
click-without-keyboard.suggestion: Use a <button>, or add role, tabindex="0" and a key handler

anchor-is-valid.description: Link with href="#" or javascript: used as a button
anchor-is-valid.suggestion: Use a <button> for an action, a real href for a link

aria-role.description: ARIA role that does not exist
aria-role.suggestion: Use a WAI-ARIA 1.2 role, or remove it

aria-hidden-focus.suggestion: Remove it from the tab order (tabindex="-1", inert) or do not hide it

iframe-title.suggestion: Add title that says what the frame holds

skip-link.description: No way to skip the navigation
skip-link.suggestion: Add a first link Skip to content and id="main" on

focus-visible.description: Focus outline removed with nothing in its place
focus-visible.suggestion: Keep an outline, or give :focus-visible a ring, border or shadow

color-contrast.description: Text contrast below 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text)
color-contrast.suggestion: Darken the text or lighten the background until the ratio passes

target-size.suggestion: Make it at least 24×24 px, padding included, or space it from its neighbours

color-contrast-enhanced.description: Text contrast below 7:1 (4.5:1 for large text)
color-contrast-enhanced.suggestion: Darken the text or lighten the background until the ratio passes

ax-name.description: Control the screen reader announces without a name
ax-name.suggestion: Give it text, a label or aria-label

ax-image-name.description: Image the screen reader announces without a name
ax-image-name.suggestion: Add alt text, or alt="" if it is decorative

focus-order.description: Tab jumps back up the page
focus-order.suggestion: Order the markup as it reads, and avoid positive tabindex

no-focusable.description: Nothing on the page can be reached with Tab
no-focusable.suggestion: Use real links and buttons, or make controls focusable

dialog-focus.description: Focus leaves an open modal dialog
dialog-focus.suggestion: Keep the focus inside the dialog while it is open (inert background or a focus trap)
